members: public static Mono<Long> countRows(DatabaseClient client, String table) { if (!java.util.Set.of("telemetry_sample", "event_revision", "audit_trail").contains(table)) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported table: " + table); } return client.sql("SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM " + table).map((row, meta) -> row.get(0, Long.class)).one(); }
